description: What they are saying in the toll-yard this week. Roll when the party asks around Ashwake Hollow.
name: Hollow Rumours

results.description: A cart came down the pass before dawn with no drover on it, and the toll-keeper waved it straight through.
The signal-tower on the ridge lit twice at midnight. Nobody has walked up to look.
The gate crew seized a crate that was warm to the touch. It is still in the weigh-house.
Three drovers refused the same run this week. Good coin, too. Nobody says why.
A tinker at the crossroads is paying double for anything dug out of the ash flats.
The tower-keeper has not been seen in a tenday, but the light still burns every night.
